what: Don't pad time estimates with safety multipliers. When I said "4-8 hours" for the better-sqlite3 → bun:sqlite shim (Option A), the user pushed back and the actual scope was 45-90 minutes: 5 source files, a 20-line shim, small shared API surface (prepare/exec/pragma/transaction/close). Pattern: before quoting a range, grep the actual blast radius (files touched, API calls affected), then estimate. Err toward the tight end; don't reflexively double-up for "unknowns" unless there's a specific named unknown.
why: Direct user correction this turn. Persisting so future me doesn't reflexively pad — the user consistently wants tight numbers backed by concrete blast-radius data.
